properties.name: veto.memory.store
properties.description: Memory backend: memory, jpa, vector, or pgvector.

properties.name: veto.security.deployer-policy
properties.description: Active install-time path and tenant policy. PROTECTED, SANDBOXED, and TENANT use their matching veto.security section; FULL_ACCESS needs no additional settings.

properties.name: veto.security.screening-mode
properties.description: Per-session auto-approval matrix. DANGEROUS always requires authorization and CRITICAL is always refused.

properties.name: veto.terminal.enabled
properties.description: Whether the local terminal IPC server is enabled.

properties.name: veto.terminal.bind-address
properties.description: ZeroMQ bind address for the local terminal IPC server.

properties.name: veto.webfetch.timeout-seconds
properties.description: HTTP request timeout for web_fetch in seconds.

properties.name: veto.webfetch.max-chars
properties.description: Maximum rendered characters returned by web_fetch.

properties.name: veto.webfetch.allow-private-addresses
properties.description: Allow web_fetch to contact loopback, link-local, private, or multicast destinations. Keep disabled unless agents must access a trusted intranet.

values.description: Host paths are unrestricted; Gateway screening and HITL remain active.
